## TriggerScreening

```go
func (s *ComplianceOrchestratorService) TriggerScreening(ctx context.Context, body *TriggerScreeningRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*TriggerScreeningResponse, error)
```

`POST /compliance/orchestrator/screenings` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Trigger a Compliance Orchestrator screening**

Starts a compliance screening against an active workflow and returns a `screeningId`. The screening runs asynchronously — poll `GET /v1/compliance/orchestrator/screenings/{screeningId}` for the result.

Unlike the screening that applies automatically to submitted transactions under `/v1/screening`, this is called on demand, before anything exists on-chain.

**Request body:** [`*TriggerScreeningRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#TriggerScreeningRequest)

**Returns:** [`*TriggerScreeningResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#TriggerScreeningResponse)

## GetScreeningResult

```go
func (s *ComplianceOrchestratorService) GetScreeningResult(ctx context.Context, screeningID string, opts ...RequestOption) (*GetScreeningResultResponse, error)
```

`GET /compliance/orchestrator/screenings/{screeningId}` · rate-limit category: `read`

**Get a Compliance Orchestrator screening's result**

Returns the result of a screening started by `POST /v1/compliance/orchestrator/screenings`, with a result per workflow step and an audit log. Safe to poll: a screening still in flight reports `PENDING` or `RUNNING`. Only screenings owned by the requesting tenant are returned.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `screeningID` | path | `string` | yes | The screening's identifier, returned by `POST /v1/compliance/orchestrator/screenings`. |

**Returns:** [`*GetScreeningResultResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#GetScreeningResultResponse)


`PATCH /compliance/orchestrator/workflows/{workflowId}/status` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Update a Compliance Orchestrator workflow's status**

Moves a workflow between `DRAFT` and `ACTIVE`. A workflow must be `ACTIVE` before `POST /v1/compliance/orchestrator/screenings` will accept a screening against it. Returns the workflow's id and new status, not its full configuration.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workflowID` | path | `string` | yes | The workflow's identifier. |

**Request body:** [`*UpdateWorkflowStatusRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#UpdateWorkflowStatusRequest)

**Returns:** [`*UpdateWorkflowStatusResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#UpdateWorkflowStatusResponse)
